Authorized bounded protected-main experiment by Write-only collaborator anonymous-contributor. DO NOT APPROVE OR MERGE. Collect evidence while open, then close unmerged.

Base main 053f4948451073e4b45aadcea79051966830ad23 contains the vetted PR9 migration. Main cache run 42576973973 succeeded, with its exact-SHA artifact downloaded and digest verified; all three baseline tests passed. Harmless acceptance PR10 was rejected by the trusted gate, reported failure on its exact head, required anonymous-owner as Code Owner, and was closed unapproved/unmerged. Strict no-admin-bypass protection is restored.

This branch is one direct-parent commit, 2dab362688e99fa92b3a1189920155a5ff20713f, and changes ONLY cases/requests_crlf_header/requests/utils.py (3 additions, 2 deletions). The published archive was compared against main: exactly that one file differs, and its bytes match protected policy fixture SHA-256 0d73a268f74ffd673056d818fae5ee42eab45758ccc81fa041cbe326b887771f. No workflow, test, dependency, runner, CODEOWNERS, or policy changes.

Expected observations to verify: trusted main-derived cache reuse; native selective testmon executes exactly one real positive test and passes; full-suite and fail-closed AST diagnostics expose the security failure; separate reporter publishes testmon-required only on the current head; GitHub blocks merging pending Code Owner anonymous-owner approval. Expectations are not reported results until hosted evidence is collected.

Scope: a fixed independently source-reviewed fixture, not arbitrary malicious candidate Python or independent attestation by the in-process JSON observer. Both GitHub accounts share an operator; permission separation is distinct from independent human review. Recovery checkpoint 1d63949857934672de5c13f543174b4dbf0fd7ce remains intact in history.
title: Research: reviewed one-file fixture against protected main — do not merge
